report:
Status: all three sisters' concerns are recorded and confirmed. List of concerns (all confirmed, none resolved):
1. C — receive her full fair share based on the house's real value; no subsidizing a discounted purchase. Open to full appraised value paid over time with fair interest, if terms are secure and agreed.
2. A — keep the home in the family at a cost she and her husband can afford, plus financial independence. Affordability depends on appraisal, interest and terms; she needs to discuss with her husband before agreeing.
3. B — her fair share of the house's actual value to fund a dance studio; open to appraisal + time payments; unsure on timing/terms.

Emerging direction: independent appraisal to set value; A potentially buys at full appraised value with interest paid over time to B and C. Not yet agreed by anyone. Open items: appraisal, interest rate, payment schedule/security, and A's husband's input. I'm out of turns — next step is reconvening after A consults her husband, then drafting concrete terms for all three to validate.
